column3: NASB renders “spread quickly” as “spread rapidly” and adds “it did.”
NASB renders “not all are of the faith” as “not all have faith.”
NASB renders “keep” as “protect” and “the evil” as “the evil one.”
NASB follows the critical text without “to you”; it renders “we have been persuaded” as “we have confidence” and adds “continue to.”
NASB reads “you received,” following other manuscripts; the critical text has “they received.” “Withdraw” is rendered “keep aloof,” and “walking idly” is “leads an unruly life.”
NASB renders “imitate us” as “follow our example” and “we were not idle” as “we did not act in an undisciplined manner.”
NASB follows the critical text (“night and day”); “without payment” is rendered “without paying for it.”
NASB adds “to this” and renders “an example” as “a model.”
NASB renders “we were commanding” as “we used to give you this order.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB renders “walking idly” as “leading an undisciplined life.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in the Lord Jesus Christ”); “warn” is rendered “command.”
NASB follows the critical text (“do not associate”); it renders “take note” as “take special note” and “be ashamed” as “be put to shame.”
NASB restructures the verse and renders “sign” as “distinguishing mark.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Amen” and the Textus Receptus subscription.
